name: overte-mcp
description: Overte (open-source Vircadia-lineage metaverse) Model Context Protocol server for domain administration and in-world entity orchestration

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Retrieve SOTA standard health telemetry.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List MCP tools with descriptions and input schemas.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List available Overte skills.

tools.name: get_overte_skill
tools.description: Return the overte-admin skill content.

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: CUA smoke-test required endpoint: tool list + system info.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Query the ring-buffer log.

tools.name: get_domain_status
tools.description: Query domain-server status telemetry.

tools.name: detect_app
tools.description: Detect Overte installation and running processes.

tools.name: start_app
tools.description: Launch an Overte binary (domain-server or interface).

tools.name: stop_app
tools.description: Kill an Overte binary (domain-server or interface).

tools.name: list_scripts
tools.description: List all entity scripts with descriptions and metadata.

tools.name: get_script
tools.description: Get a script's content by name.

tools.name: create_script
tools.description: Create a new entity script.

tools.name: update_script
tools.description: Update a script's content and/or metadata.

tools.name: delete_script
tools.description: Delete a script and remove it from the manifest.

tools.name: list_tracked_entities
tools.description: Return all entities tracked by this server (spawned via bridge).

tools.name: clear_tracked_entities
tools.description: Clear the tracked entity list.

tools.name: post_entity_spawn
tools.description: Spawn an in-world entity (via WebSocket bridge if connected, else falls back to simulated).

tools.name: post_script_inject
tools.description: Inject a JavaScript entity script (via WebSocket bridge if connected, else falls back to simulated).

tools.name: overte_domain_status
tools.description: overte_domain_status

tools.name: overte_entity_spawn
tools.description: overte_entity_spawn

tools.name: overte_script_inject
tools.description: overte_script_inject

tools.name: overte_sampling_assist
tools.description: overte_sampling_assist
